chunks: For them are higher ranks with God, and forgiveness and grace; and God is forgiving and kind.

key_terms.دَرَجَاتٍ: ranks or degrees of spiritual elevation

ai.seo_question: What are the spiritual rewards and divine attributes mentioned for the righteous in this Quranic verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the concept of *Darajat* (spiritual ranks) which are attained through adherence to the Ahl al-Bayt and righteous deeds, serving as a promise for the faithful in the Hereafter. The concluding attributes of *Ghafur* (All-Forgiving) and *Rahim* (All-Mercy) underscore the balance between divine justice and grace, a central theme in Shia theology regarding the intercession of the Imams.
